status: Closed — beta.4 CI verified tag-versioned artifacts before all publish gates on 2026-08-30
finding: The release workflow injected tag-derived workspace versions only after build, package-content, artifact-budget, and clean-install gates. Those gates therefore verified an unversioned tarball rather than the exact version npm would publish.
expectedBehavior: A tag release must inject the final version before building any release artifact. Every pre-publish package gate must observe the same versioned tarball that the publish step sends to npm.
evidenceOrRepro: In .github/workflows/release-npm.yml, Set npm package versions from tag followed Clean-install npx smoke (publish gate). The published beta.2 registry package reported its own version at runtime, proving manifest version is runtime-relevant. scripts/validate-breaking-changes.ts now asserts version injection precedes build, package verification, and clean-install smoke.
containment: The workflow is reordered without removing any gate. 0.1.0-beta.1 is deny-listed with 0.1.0-beta.2 as its replacement because beta.1 was known to lack standalone tarball closure.
followUp: Run 33312011105 on v0.1.0-beta.4 injected the tag version before build, package verification, artifact budget, and clean-install smoke; all steps passed, and npm exposes @ai-atomic-framework/cli@0.1.0-beta.4 under next. Trusted Publishing remains a separate credential-hardening follow-up.
